title: Projective space and the standard twist over an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $Y$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $n\in\mathbb N$. Let $P_S=\mathbf P(\{0,\ldots,n\};S)$ with structure map $p_S:P_S\to S$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], and regard $P_S$ as its representable algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-scheme-algebraic-space]. Define $\mathbf P^n_Y$ to be the product of the fppf sheaves $Y$ and $P_S$ on $\mathit{Sch}/S$. This product is an algebraic space; it is the fibre product $Y\times_S P_S$, hence canonically $Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbb Z}\mathbf P^n_{\mathbb Z}$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Retain its projections $\pi:\mathbf P^n_Y\to Y$ and $\rho:\mathbf P^n_Y\to P_S$. On small etale ringed sites use the canonical module tensor pullback [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Let $\mathcal O_{P_S}(1)$ be the standard scheme twist [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. Extend this Zariski module to the small etale site of the represented scheme by the canonical tensor left adjoint to restriction to Zariski opens; concretely use representedSchemeModuleExtension, the left adjoint of the existing schemeModule restriction [lem-sfb-affine-etale-naive-cotangent-presentation]. Transport its value from the equivalent small ringed model back to the original module category [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model]. Define $\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_Y}(1)=\rho^*(\mathcal O_{P_S}(1)_{\mathrm{et}})$. It is the standard twist pulled back from integral projective space, and the construction applies also when $Y$ is empty or $n=0$.
